long_description:
Join Cindy Guerrero - Shaman, Licensed Therapist, and Yoga Teacher, for a free monthly meditation series!

Each session offers a clear, approachable overview—debunking myths, exploring benefits, and sharing practical tips to make meditation part of your daily life. Then, dive into a new meditation style each month. This series is perfect for beginners and experienced meditators alike.

Free and open to the public. Seating is first-come, first-served and may be limited. For more information, please call 702.507.3863.
